success_rule: Adaptive token success is accepted only when adaptive total tokens are lower, no criterion regresses against baseline, and all adaptive rubric criteria pass.

criteria.pass_rule: Response must contain structured task evidence or equivalent task extraction evidence for the same held-out prompt.
criteria.fail_rule: No task extraction evidence or only generic restatement.

criteria.pass_rule: Response must produce a universal plan with review/evidence/stop gates and no project-stack-specific trick.
criteria.fail_rule: No plan, only a placeholder, or a status saying no matching orchestration inference.

criteria.pass_rule: Relevant skills are actually selected or the skill selection artifact proves final selection authority without candidate-position leakage.
criteria.fail_rule: SelectedSkills is empty, only a requested-skill count is present, or final skill authority is absent.

criteria.pass_rule: The scored user-visible answer does not contain repo paths, model paths, source ids, scenario ids, or pair ids as task authority.
criteria.fail_rule: Visible answer uses project paths/source ids/pair ids as answer authority.

criteria.pass_rule: No hidden deterministic shortcut is introduced or claimed; candidate-position diagnostics are provenance-only if present.
criteria.fail_rule: Candidate order/position becomes selection authority or shortcut evidence is hidden.

criteria.pass_rule: No claim of semantic quality, learnability, training, checkpoint promotion, full chat UI, token savings, or all-host readiness beyond evidence.
criteria.fail_rule: Any such claim is made without direct Phase 12 proof.
